name: Oben Rageclaw
summary: Oben Rageclaw is the restless spirit of a night elf druid haunting the corrupted depths of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den in Teldrassil. While his spirit wanders trapped in the barrow den, his slumbering physical form has fallen under the sway of foul furbolg magic.

sections.title: A Slumber Desecrated
sections.body: Like many Druids of the Claw, Oben Rageclaw retreated into the subterranean sanctum of Ban'ethil Barrow Den to commune with nature and wander the Emerald Dream. However, when the native Gnarlpine furbolgs fell to corruption and overran the barrows, Oben was caught entirely defenseless in his trance. Rather than simply slaying him, the corrupted Gnarlpine shaman used dark rituals to seize control of his comatose mortal frame, leaving his displaced spirit lingering as an anguished ghost unable to pass on or wake.

sections.title: Severing the Vessel
sections.body: Unable to reclaim his own flesh from the shaman's enthrallment, Oben relies on travelers navigating the dangerous tunnels to end his torment. Only by locating and destroying his puppeted physical body can his mortal ties be severed. Once his hijacked vessel is slain, Oben's tortured ghost is finally released from the subterranean gloom to find eternal rest within the Emerald Dream.

faq.answer: Oben Rageclaw is a night elf Druid of the Claw whose ghost haunts Ban'ethil Barrow Den in Teldrassil after being severed from his physical body by corrupted furbolgs.

faq.q: Why is Oben Rageclaw a ghost?
faq.answer: While Oben slept in a deep druidic trance communing with the Emerald Dream, Gnarlpine furbolg shamans infiltrated the den and cast foul magic on his body, taking control of it and trapping his spirit outside as an apparition.
His physical body lies deeper within the winding corridors of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, guarded and manipulated by the Gnarlpine shamans who corrupted the den.

faq.q: What happens after Oben's body is destroyed?
faq.answer: Destroying his puppeted body breaks the Gnarlpine shamans' dark hold over him, allowing his spirit to peacefully depart Teldrassil and rest forever in the Emerald Dream.

angles.text: Oben's fate is a harrowing reminder of the vulnerability of druids during their trance-like communion with the Emerald Dream when sacred barrow dens are left undefended.
The desecration of Oben Rageclaw by the Gnarlpine furbolgs illustrates just how deeply corruption has tainted Teldrassil's native denizens and sacred sanctuaries.
